derivation: from the same as G2226 (ζῶον) and G64 (ἀγρεύω);
def: to take alive (make a prisoner of war), i.e. (figuratively) to capture or ensnare

occurrences.text: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
